note: *é clemente com todas as tuas iniquidades*: the blind reader did not know *clemente* in this sense; *é propício a* and *perdoa* are the options. The row awaits Gustavo.
*Não estará irado perpetuamente*: the Latinist asked *não se irará*, twice; held. The stylist's *para sempre … eternamente* was refused under D23.
*todos os seus poderes* follows D43; the blind reader heard it as abstract powers. *exércitos* is the option.
